summary: Isolate runtime observation capture fences by subject and expose repeated refusals

replay.detail: No replicated projection or launch replay change. Owner-local capture bookmarks survive replay and view forgetting.

schema.detail: Within the owner-local storage-19 installation, add a per-subject ledger mutation bookmark table. The existing three ledger triggers update its indexed subject row atomically after advancing the global serial. Earlier draft triggers are replaced once in the same installation transaction; existing ledger history needs no backfill because its mutations predate new captures. No extra storage-version increment or replicated table.

rules.detail: No claim, signing, checkpoint or actor authorization rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Only ledger mutations for the observed subject can invalidate its pre-physical capture serial; unrelated starts cannot starve exit or absence publication. The same actual-incarnation exception remains limited to ordinary observations. A bounded-label telemetry counter records refusals; three consecutive drops for one subject open an existing reconcile fault, and fresh admission recovers it. Diagnostic-counter changes are queued as incremental inputs for the next pass, and the counter saturates at its fault threshold so an unchanged refusal does not spin the reactive loop. This is not stop-only identity or closure authority. A signing-key preparation failure refuses admission before any physical/control start request or ledger row is written.

downtime.detail: No additional interruption beyond the classified deployment restart.

manual.detail: No new release or closure command. Permanent ledger/request snapshots and bookmarks remain stored; resolved evidence pins release, not ledger rows.

recovery.detail: The classified forward-only database/runtime preservation procedure remains required. No header downgrade or unproven closure release.
